source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Star Topology' (PDF 10): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Star topology mein tamam devices ek central (beech wale) hub ya switch se jurte hain (jaise Figure 1.9 mein). Data isi central device se guzarta hai. Ise manage karna (sambhalna) aur expand karna (barhana) aasan hai. Ek device fail ho to baqi par asar nahi parta. Central hub fail ho jaye to network ruk jata hai. Aaj ke networks mein star topology bohat istemal hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Star topology: desktop computer, mobile phone, laptop aur printer har aik teer wali tooti lakeer se aik darmiyani hub ya switch se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.9: Star topology (kitab ki Figure 1.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Star topology ki sab se bari kamzori kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Central hub ya switch kharab ho jaye to poora network ruk jata hai.

items: Star: sab devices central hub/switch se; sambhalna aur barhana aasan; ek device kharab to baqi theek; hub kharab to sab band.
